The webhook is configured with a CA certificate from CN=cluster-policy-ca, but the webhook server TLS certificate in the pod-policy-webhook-tls secret is signed by CN=platform-services-ca. This CA mismatch causes the Kubernetes API server to fail TLS verification when calling the webhook (error: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority), and because the webhook failurePolicy is set to Fail, all pod creation attempts in the hotel-reservation namespace are blocked. The recommendation deployment has 0/1 pods running as a result.
